Entity.save.returns.status.description: Values of the `status` property of the object returned by Entity.save.

values.name: dk status automerge failed
values.description: (Only if the dk auto merge option is used) The automatic merge option failed when saving the entity. Associated statusText: "Auto merge failed"

values.name: dk status entity does not exist anymore
values.description: The entity no longer exists in the data. This error can occur in the following cases:the entity has been dropped (the stamp has changed and the memory space is now free)the entity has been dropped and replaced by another one with another primary key (the stamp has changed and a new entity now uses the memory space). When using .drop(), this error can be returned when dk force drop if stamp changed option is used. When using .lock(), this error can be returned when dk reload if stamp changed option is usedAssociated statusText: "Entity does not exist anymore"

values.name: dk status locked
values.description: The entity is locked by a pessimistic lock. Associated statusText: "Already locked"

values.name: dk status validation failed
values.description: Non fatal error sent by the developer for a validate event. Associated statusText: "Mild Validation Error"

values.name: dk status serious error
values.description: A serious error is a low-level database error (e.g. duplicated key), a hardware error, etc. Associated statusText: "Other error"

values.name: dk status serious validation error
values.description: Fatal error sent by the developer for a validate event. Associated statusText: "Serious Validation Error"

values.name: dk status stamp has changed
values.description: The internal stamp value of the entity does not match the one of the entity stored in the data (optimistic lock).with .save(): error only if the dk auto merge option is not usedwith .drop(): error only if the dk force drop if stamp changed option is not usedwith .lock(): error only if the dk reload if stamp changed option is not usedAssociated statusText: "Stamp has changed"

values.name: dk status wrong permission
values.description: The current privileges do not allow the save of the entity. Associated statusText: "Permission Error"
